Figure 3 - Determinants of ctDNA shedding in HPV-associated oropharyngeal cancers at baseline

David N Brown, Bill H Diplas

Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center

25 June, 2026




Figure 3a Scatter plot of cfDNA aligned HPV-16 read pairs with patient-matched primary MRI tumor volume at baseline.




Figure 3b Box plot comparing the circulating HPV-16 read pairs between hypoxic and non-hypoxic tumors at baseline as assessed by 18F-FMISO PET-CT.




Figure 3c Volcano plot of NES versus FDR adjusted p-value for Hallmark, KEGG, Reactome, and Gene Ontology pathways.




Figure 3d Heatmap of GSEA scores for select apoptosis, necrosis, and mitosis transcriptomic signatures (absolute Log2 Fold-Change≥2.5; p≤0.1) in pre-treatment primary tumors.




Figure 3e Box plots comparing GSEA scores between HPV ctDNA positive and negative pre-treatment primary tumors for caspase activation via apoptotic signaling.




Figure 3f Box plots comparing GSEA scores between HPV ctDNA positive and negative pre-treatment primary tumors for G1/S DNA damage checkpoints.




Figure 3h Forest plot showing the standardized coefficients of select transcriptomic signatures, clinical parameters, imaging, and genomic covariates in the multivariate regression predicting ctDNA shedding at baseline.




Figure 3i Stepwise regression model with backward elimination using the AIC identified tumor volume, apoptosis, necrosis, and primary tumor viral load as major contributors to baseline cHPV DNA levels.
